g.title: signing-flow
g.text: The browser verifies the API-built transaction, then signs · private key never transmitted · submission routed through the API

g.title: cluster_wallet
g.text: Private key stays inside the wallet - never enters this app

g.title: cluster_sk
g.text: For keys not held in any wallet

g.title: env
g.text: Built by the API from a live on-chain re-read
Fetched through the key-injecting web proxy · one transaction per round

g.title: review
g.text: User can inspect every operation, fee, and sequence number before signing

g.title: verify
g.text: Checks the API-built XDR against the user's own choices
Merge only to the destination or mediator · matching memo · no unknown op
Expected values come from the user, never the API - a mismatch aborts before signing

g.title: sk_in
g.text: Wiped on completion · abort · navigation away · 'Forget key' click

g.title: multisig
g.text: Signatures accumulated on same envelope · each key wiped after signing · submit when thresholds met

g.title: confirm
g.text: Shows what will change · warns it cannot be undone · user triggers submission

g.title: send
g.text: The API forwards the signed transaction to the network

g.title: poll
g.text: If response lost: check first - never re-submit without verifying

g.title: next
g.text: Transaction hash recorded in IndexedDB session
Session state transitions to STEP_CONFIRMED -> STEP_EXECUTING (next round)
